definitions.full: H7331. Rezon רְזוֺן proper name, masculine founder of kingdom of Damascus, Solomon's time , 1Kin 11:23 ; ᵐ5 ( 11:14 ) Εσρωμ [A 11:23 Ραξων ]; identified with חֶזְיוֺן 15:18 by Th Klo (reading חזרון ), but compare Kit Benz.

occurrences.englishText: God raised up an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah.
